A world-class website brief for a waterfront development. The thinking behind the building — vision, philosophy, pages, interactions, and the questions to answer before code.

① References ② Philosophy ③ Questions
What The References Do Right

Reference one is a masterclass in cinematic scrollytelling: full-viewport video, deliberate reveals, a near-silent palette. The site feels like entering a vision, not reading a brochure.

Reference two proves regional luxury can match international standards: editorial serif typography, gold accents, dark backgrounds, absolute confidence.

Three Rules That Cannot Be Broken

Silence is luxury. Luxury pages leave space; every element must earn its place. Generous padding, restrained sizes, no crowded grids.

The story moves you. The visitor is carried through a curated journey rather than left to navigate.

Earn the trust. Nothing experimental: flawless performance, real content, working forms from day one.

Questions Before We Begin

Q1 — Does the client have an existing brand identity: logo files, official colors, defined typefaces?

Q2 — Who writes the website copy, and when can drafts arrive?

Q3 — What format are the site plans in, and are they geo-referenced?
